en: Black‑and‑white panoramic view of a city surrounded by mountains. In the foreground are dense low-rise buildings; in the mid‑ground stands a large ancient temple complex with tall columns (the Temple of Olympian Zeus) and an open archaeological area. Beyond it lies a wooded hill and, further back, a large stadium-like structure. Handwritten-style text near the bottom left reads something like "VIEW OF ATHENS," and a printed watermark at the bottom right shows a website address.
